title: subscription-mollie now advertises its priceToTier map to billing-foundation
detail: createSubscriptionMollieFeature already required and validated a priceToTier option (drift-checked against priceToConfig at boot), but never put it on the SubscriptionProviderPlugin object it registers. billing-foundation's new create-checkout-session hardening rejects any mode:"subscription" checkout from a provider with no priceToTier as provider_has_no_price_catalog. Without this fix, every existing Mollie-configured app would fail every subscription checkout after upgrading.
